town_description: Itanagar, the capital of Arunachal Pradesh in the Papum Pare district, sits in the Himalayan foothills. Ganga Lake (also called Gekar Sinyi or Gyakar Sinyi), about 6 km from Itanagar, is a small natural forest lake surrounded by primeval vegetation, orchids and tree ferns, popular for boating and picnics; a small temple of Maa Ganga stands beside it (per visitor reviews).

travel.airport: Lilabari Airport (Assam) is the commonly cited nearest airport in travel guides; the newer Donyi Polo Airport (Holongi) now serves the Itanagar region (verify distance).
travel.railway: Naharlagun Railway Station, approx. 15-18 km from Ganga Lake.
travel.road: Ganga Lake is about 6 km from Itanagar, reached by road toward the Ganga area; the small temple stands beside the lake (verify exact spot).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March, the pleasant season for Itanagar.
